title: game-video:upsert-component args
description: Flat optional-fields schema. The framework cannot pass union (anyOf/oneOf) tool arguments, so the single-control vs template distinction is validated by the service: provide id/events/implementation to author a control, provide compose to assemble a template, or provide both to create a control and assemble it in one call. Providing neither is rejected by the service.

id.description: Stable component id used by OverlayChild.component and base:<id>. Required when authoring a single control, or when composing a template that also creates a brand-new control in the same call.

label.description: User-facing name shown under Basic UI.

prompt.description: 面向 AI 的摆放位置与潜规则提示：元件一般放在页面的什么位置、以及一些潜规则（如血条不建议同一场景出现两次；敌方血条一般放在页面顶部水平居中位置；我方血条一般放在页面右下角）。配界面时据此决定元件放在哪。

inputs.description: Manifest-driven configuration fields rendered in the right inspector. Every field must declare a default whose JSON type matches valueType. Color fields use valueType=color and a ColorPicker-compatible default such as #rrggbb or rgba(r,g,b,a); component=color is not required.

default.description: Required initial value. Must match valueType; when options are present it must equal one option.value.

events.description: Events emitted through props.emit(eventId) and exposed in the event editor. Required when authoring a single control, or when the composed template also creates a new control in the same call.

implementation.description: A JavaScript expression evaluating to a React component, usually `function MyControl(props) { ... }`. React is injected in lexical scope; use React.createElement and React hooks, and never redeclare or shadow React with a variable, function, class, parameter, destructuring target, or catch binding. Do not use import, export, JSX, TypeScript, external packages, or undeclared identifiers. Inputs arrive as flat props; call props.emit(eventId) for declared events. The tool validates the implementation before writing. When validation fails, fix the reported implementation defect and call this tool again; do not report the component as created until the tool succeeds. Required when authoring a single control, or when the composed template also creates a new control in the same call.

compose.description: Assemble a multi-control template (overlay). Omit to author a single control, which lands in the 控件 directory as base:<id>. When present, the children are written to ui.overlays as a reusable template in the 模板 directory; a brand-new control may be created in the same call by also providing id/events/implementation.

id.description: Overlay id stored under ui.overlays. Omit to auto-derive scheme-<slug> from the title. Must not start with base: or node:.

title.description: Template display name shown in the 模板 directory.

prompt.description: 面向 AI 的整块模板摆放提示：这张拼好的模板作为一个整体一般放在视频画布的什么位置（例如「我方状态 HUD 一般放在右下角」）。

component.description: Existing control id (built-in, previously authored, or the new control created in this same call).
